subject: Culture
title: Coronation Ceremonies
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Coronation Ceremonies.

hook.text: British coronations use a stone brought from Scotland in 1296 and an ampulla shaped like an eagle.

buildup.text: Coronation rituals are designed to make power look divine. Anointing with oil echoes biblical kings.

discovery.text: Japan's emperor performs a secret harvest ritual alone. No one witnesses the moment of divine transition.

twist.text: Napoleon grabbed the crown from the Pope and crowned himself. He rewrote the ritual to claim self-made authority.

climax.text: A crown is just metal. The ceremony is what transforms it into authority everyone agrees to obey.

quiz.question: What did Napoleon famously do during his coronation?
options: Crowned himself instead of letting the Pope do it
